The case shape and bracelet look like an Omega Constellation? Let me think — the bracelet has a distinctive look with polished links. The dial appears blue with horizontal teak-like lines... Actually the dial appears to have vertical stripe pattern (teak dial) — that's Omega Aqua Terra. The Aqua Terra 150M Master Co-Chronometer with blue teak dial and steel bracelet, reference 220.10.41.21.03.001 (41mm) or 231.10.42.21.03.001.

Looking at the watch: date at 3 o'clock, arrow-shaped hands? Actually Aqua Terra has "broad arrow" hour hand. The case has lyre-shaped lugs? Hmm, the lugs look fairly straight. The dial looks dark blue with vertical streaks — teak pattern.

I'll go with Omega Seamaster Aqua Terra 150M, ref 220.10.41.21.03.002? Let's consider: 41mm blue teak dial, steel bracelet — 220.10.41.21.03.001 is the 41mm blue teak (2017). The .03.002 is the 41mm with blue dial... Actually 220.10.41.21.03.001 = blue dial, steel bracelet (41mm). Confidence moderate.

The crown guards and case look like Aqua Terra. I'll answer that.

Movement: automatic (Calibre 8900). Case material: stainless steel. Bracelet: metal.

Confidence 0.35.
